newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end weaker, off day's lows.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end weaker, off day's lows.

text.p: Leading UK shares ended with moderate losses on Monday as the Dow got off to a wobbly start after a 148-point plunge on Friday.
The benchmark FTSE 100 index of leading shares shed 19.0 points to settle at 4,251.7, as decliners beat advancers by a margin of two to one.
The Dow was down about 20 points when London markets closed.
Dealers said they were relieved that the early drop on Wall Street appeared to be contained as several big U.S. companies posted strong results.
